Haphazard
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Random.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Haphazard" means lacking any obvious order or organization; done without a plan. Its closest synonym among the options is "random". (अव्यवस्थित)

◦ Example: The files were arranged in such a haphazard (random) manner that nobody could find anything quickly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Strengthen" means to strengthen something against attack or make it more resilient — different in sense from "haphazard".

• Option 3 "Hinder" means to delay or prevent something by obstructing it — different in sense from "haphazard".

• Option 4 "Mild" means having a mild, kind, or tender temperament or manner — different in sense from "haphazard".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of haphazard: random. Antonyms: organized, systematic, methodical, orderly.
